title: Qualcomm Incorporated
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Qualcomm dominates smartphone application processors (Snapdragon) and modems, with a royalty business model on every CDMA/LTE/5G handset shipped globally. The edge AI opportunity is significant: Snapdragon X Elite brings PC-class AI inference to thin-and-light laptops, competing directly with Apple Silicon. Server-class ARM CPU for data centres (Cloud AI 100) positions QCOM in the emerging ARM server market. Royalty revenue provides durable recurring cash flow regardless of chip shipment mix.

Future Tech Roadmap

AI Inference at Edge Confirmed 2025
On-device AI inference running foundation models on smartphones, PCs, and IoT devices without cloud connectivity
📈 Snapdragon X Elite (Hexagon NPU at 45 TOPS) and Snapdragon 8 Gen 4 power most flagship Android AI phones. QCOM benefits from every premium smartphone shipped with on-device LLM capability.
ARM-Based Server CPUs Confident 2027
ARM architecture reaching 40%+ share of new data centre CPU deployments
📈 Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 and Snapdragon X servers target hyperscaler and enterprise inference workloads. As ARM server penetration grows, QCOM's royalty business and chip revenue both benefit.
